dict.string: Double jump to get over the red hurdles.
Try jumping over one hurdle, then double jumping to get over the next hurdle.
Try sprinting through the sand pits.
Press the action button to cheer and gain health.
Press the action button in front of other people to gain double health.
Try double jumping early to get over the pigs.
Press the action button to kick the chickens.
Kicked chickens are the best way to defeat cows.
Don't double-jump when you see a crow.
Press the action button to shuffle past the other dancers.
Press the action button to cheer and gain health.
Sprint to get enough speed to get over the long pits.
Press the action button in front of other people to gain double health.
Sprint to get enough speed to get over the long pits.
Press the action button to block the ship's attacks.
Blocking the ship's attacks will give you health.
Press the action button to blow out the fire demons.
Blow the fire off the foxes to jump over them easier.
Press the sprint button when it gets windy.
You can jump as much as you want in this level.
Press and hold the action button to dive down faster after jumping.
Sprint on the ground to speed up to get faster times.
Press the action button to detonate any bombs you see.
Sprint to outrun the bombs Jim throws.
Jump on the minecarts to help get past the spikes.
Jump on the treadmills pointing right to gain extra speeds.
You can jump again in the air. This will help you get over hurdles.
The battery shows how much health you have left.
Press the sprint button to run faster. Then you can press it again to slow back down.
